title: Why They’re Not Picking You (And What Recruiters Actually Want)
description:
If you’re not getting hired — even with the right experience — this is why.

It’s not that you’re not qualified. It’s that you don’t feel like a safe bet.

In this video, I break down recruiter psychology and how hiring managers actually make decisions — so you can stop guessing and start positioning yourself as the obvious choice.

Hiring decisions come down to three things:

Do I like them?
Do I trust them?
Do they feel like a safe hire?

If your answers don’t clearly show how you solve problems and deliver results, you’re getting passed over.

Start focusing on:
 how you think
 how you solve problems
 and the results you’ve delivered

That’s what gets you hired.

transcript: The reason you're not getting hired isn't what you think. It's not that you're not qualified, it's that you don't feel like a safe bet. Hiring managers are trying to avoid a bad hire just as much as finding a good hire. So, while you're focused on saying the right answers, they're thinking, "Do I like them? Do I trust them to deliver? And can I actually see myself and my team working with them every day?" That's it. And if your answers don't make them feel confident that you can solve their problems, you're getting passed over. So, stop worrying about sounding impressive and start showing how you think, how you solve problems, and the result you've already delivered. That's what gets you hired. Follow me at Kirsten Careers if you want more strategies that most job seekers never learn.
